title: Measured evidence carries articulated mark provenance
headline: Obsmetrologia.measure_positive_marks_in_trace

requirements.statement: A positive measured pole at a cell has an articulating source in the measured trace.
Positive evidence carries the cell coordinate marks into trace mark provenance.
Negative evidence carries the contradictory cell coordinate marks into trace mark provenance.

prohibitions.statement: Provenance must pass through witnesses and an articulating in the trace, not a Reading by itself.

blueprint.label: thm:measured-mark-provenance
blueprint.title: Measured poles are witnessed by articulated marks in the trace
blueprint.statement: Positive evidence has an articulating source for the queried cell; negative evidence has one for its contradictory; relevant primitive marks remain in trace provenance.
